explication: npm is a JavaScript package-manager CLI. A user invokes npm, the CLI dispatches a command, and that command resolves or inspects package metadata, updates the local dependency tree, communicates with a registry when needed, and formats a result or error. The graph preserves major install, query, search, audit, publish, execution, configuration, authentication, and versioning capabilities. Some command internals are unsampled, so only documented or source-supported relationships are shown; optional registry lookups are dashed.
